meta.title: Seafood & Aquaculture: Fish Supply from Egypt
meta.description: AZAFCO's core business: farmed fish sourcing, processing, packing and export coordination for importers, distributors, foodservice and hotel buyers.

hero.title: Seafood is the core of AZAFCO
hero.intro: We connect aquaculture production and sourcing with processing, packing and export coordination, so commercial buyers get the information they need to plan purchasing and supply.

chain.title: From origin to your destination
chain.intro: Each order follows the same path. The specification agreed with you guides every step.
chain.farm_text: Fish comes from aquaculture production linked to AZAFCO's core business, matched to the species, quantities and timing buyers need.
chain.select_text: Product is selected and graded against the size and quality agreed for the order.
chain.process_text: Fish are prepared in the factory according to the agreed specification and applicable requirements.
chain.pack_text: Pack type, net weight and labels follow the specification confirmed in writing.
chain.export_text: Shipping options and the documents each order needs are reviewed before dispatch.

species.title: What we supply
species.intro: Open a species for its specification card, or search the full catalogue.

farm.title: Supply that starts at the source
farm.text_1: Fish comes from aquaculture production linked to AZAFCO's core business. Our team works to understand each buyer's commercial needs: which species, what quantities and when.

processing.title: Prepared to the agreed specification
processing.text: Export orders are handled by selecting, grading, processing and packing the product according to the specification agreed with the customer and the requirements that apply.
processing.point_1: Grading against the size range in your order
processing.point_2: Packing, net weight and labels as confirmed in writing
processing.point_3: Results reviewed before the shipment leaves

requirements.title: Start with the specification
requirements.intro: Tell us the species, size, presentation, packing, order volume and destination. The team will contact you to review what can be delivered.
requirements.format_text: Whole or another presentation; fresh or frozen only where offered.
requirements.grade_text: The size grade and quality requirements for your market.
requirements.weight_text: Weight range per piece and net weight per pack.
requirements.packing_text: Pack type, labels and label language.
requirements.destination_text: Country, city, delivery terms and required documents.

quality.title: Quality you can check, not just read about
quality.text: Quality starts with a clear specification and is shown through records. You can review the product specification and the facility or shipment documents that apply to your order.

audience.title: Built for commercial buyers
audience.partners: Companies looking for a long-term supply partner

cta.title: Discuss your seafood requirements
cta.intro: Specify the species, weight, processing, packing, order volume and destination country. The export team will review whether it can be delivered and contact you.
cta.label: Request a Quote
